name: 05-earl-grey-blush-three-quarter
prompt:
Use case: compositing / product-mockup. Create ONE finished photorealistic MINIMALIST product catalogue photograph, portrait 3:4 ideally exactly 1086 x 1448.
Input image 1 is approved product and typography master. Edit its scene/lighting only as specified below; maintain its exact drink, packaging and typography. One complete cup with clear dome lid, front-facing recognizable girl-and-two-ear-bunny 128am Cafe sticker. Exact real short transparent sundae cup proportions. Thin 4–5% amber-brown Earl Grey syrup band visible at bottom, creamy beige Earl Grey milk, rich natural green matcha marbling, low smooth soft cold foam lightly dusted with matcha inside dome. Foam is not a piped whipped cream tower. Preserve restrained realistic fine condensation.
Entire exterior dome, cup and projecting lid flange must be clean with NO overflow, NO green paste, NO exterior smears or drips. Clear clean flange and properly seated lid; green drink and foam stay inside. No added ingredients or garnishes.
Typography EXACTLY matches the master size, placement and rounded Fredoka-style typeface. Solid muted rose #B8496C lowercase headline on exactly TWO lines 'earl grey' then 'matcha latte'; smaller exact '128am Cafe' in same rounded font below. No additional tracking. Centered header with comfortable top and side margins. No other text, prices, badges, claims, watermarks or slogans.
MINIMALISM ABSOLUTE: only ONE cup, one seamless plain background/surface, subtle restrained soft shadow, generous negative space. NO PROPS: no bowl, tea leaves, chasen, flowers, plants, cloth, patterns, furniture, windows, pedestal, tray, graphic shapes, texture clutter or scenery in frame. Genuine appetising photograph with natural colours, never CGI or illustration. Full cup and lid and base with comfortable margins, no cropping.
SCENE: Plain pale blush seamless studio and matte surface. Camera ELEVATED at approximately 30 degrees looking DOWN in a three-quarter product portrait, distinctly higher than the straight-on master. Show broader ellipse of dome opening and more visible surface of the cold foam through the clear dome, while still showing the full cup and front logo clearly. Use real changed camera perspective, do not merely copy master cup angle. Keep cup slightly right of center (4% image width), same centered master header. Soft natural side daylight.
visual_qa: Passed: minimal prop-free scene, full cup, exact headline, girl and two-ear bunny, thin amber syrup, clean exterior rim; clear elevated 3/4 camera difference.
